highlights.title: Moraes ou Mendonça: quem terá maioria no caso Master no STF? Entenda
highlights.summary: No Grande Debate Eleições, analista Caio Junqueira avalia, segundo o entorno dos ministro do Supremo, três votos contra a apuração, três favoráveis e quatro ainda indefinidos

highlights.title: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party
highlights.summary: The Iranian Red Crescent and says five people, including a child, were killed and 50 injured when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home.

highlights.title: Germany says Russia preparing ‘hybrid’ attacks over Ukraine support
highlights.summary: Germany says an attempted drone attack at Leipzig Airport showed hallmarks of Russian hybrid operations against Ukraine.

highlights.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
highlights.summary: High profile Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong has pleaded guilty to collusion with foreign entities.

highlights.title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
highlights.summary: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

highlights.title: Tunisia’s civil society faces growing pressure as crackdown widens
highlights.summary: Arrests, prosecutions and suspensions are putting growing pressure on Tunisia’s civil society, Human Rights Watch says.
